reason: I don't know this website and it wants my resume and my data before I know what I'm getting. I already get placement prep free from one creator's playlists, and I rarely pay for anything, so 299 a month for an AI mentor I haven't tried is not something I'd spend on.
objection: Why would a new site I've never heard of be trusted with my resume and my personal data, when I can't see how it's used or who runs it?
would_change_my_mind: A free trial of the Pro features with no card needed, and a clear note on what happens to my resume and data, would make me willing to try it.
